header.title: System Statistics
header.subtitle: A unified view of platforms, messages, and model calls.

platformCount.label: Platform Instances
platformCount.note: Configured and currently running platform instances

modelTotal.title: Token usage · {range}
modelTotal.quotaNote: Recorded tokens differ from OAuth subscription usage. Missing historical usage cannot be recovered.
modelTotal.scopeNote: Calls count observable provider invocations, excluding opaque SDK retries. Tokens come from response usage. Separate tool charges and other clients sharing the account cannot be reconstructed from local records.
modelTotal.windowNote: Rolling window ending now, unlike the calendar-day total above.
modelTotal.coverageNote: Coverage includes complete or partial usage reports among new-format call records; legacy records are excluded. Unreported consumption remains unknown.

usageDimensions.sameCallsNote: Each dimension groups the same calls; do not add dimensions together.

errors.loadFailed: Failed to load statistics. Please try again later.
errors.rangeFailed: Failed to switch the statistics range. Please try again later.
